pairs.transfer: 平坦度、粗糙度與顆粒控制，會決定兩片晶圓能否形成完整接合界面。
pairs.transferEn: Flatness, roughness and particles influence whether two wafers can form a continuous bonding interface.
pairs.difference: 研磨拋光以材料移除與表面品質為輸出；混合接合還必須處理介電層與金屬接點的對位和電性連接。
pairs.differenceEn: Grinding and polishing remove material and prepare a surface; hybrid bonding additionally aligns dielectric and metal interfaces and establishes electrical connections.
practice: 畫出移除材料與接合材料的兩條流程
列出厚度、粗糙度、顆粒三種不同量測
用假想缺陷圖說明何處可能形成空洞
practiceEn: Sketch removal and bonding as separate flows
Distinguish thickness, roughness and particle measurements
Use a hypothetical defect map to predict void locations

pairs.transfer: 晶圓表面是後續微影、薄膜與量測的共同起點，前段形貌會向後續工序傳遞。
pairs.transferEn: The wafer surface is a shared starting point for lithography, films and metrology; upstream geometry propagates downstream.
pairs.difference: 晶圓原材料拋光與元件層間的化學機械平坦化目的不同，不能沿用同一材料組合或合格判準。
pairs.differenceEn: Starting-wafer polishing and interlayer chemical-mechanical planarization have different purposes and cannot share an assumed material stack or acceptance criterion.
practice: 標出裸晶圓與已加工晶圓的差別
連結一項表面缺陷與一道後續工序
寫出需要量測後才能接受的表面條件
practiceEn: Distinguish a bare wafer from a processed wafer
Link one surface defect to a downstream operation
State which surface condition requires measurement before acceptance

pairs.transfer: 晶圓接合可以為背面加工提供支撐，也可以形成垂直互連；必須先分清接合的用途。
pairs.transferEn: Wafer bonding can support backside processing or form vertical interconnects; its purpose must be defined first.
pairs.difference: 背面供電重整電源路徑；混合接合連接兩個器件或晶圓界面，並非每一個支撐接合都含金屬互連。
pairs.differenceEn: Backside power reorganizes power routing; hybrid bonding connects device or wafer interfaces, and not every support bond contains metal interconnects.
practice: 分別畫出支撐接合與電性接合
標示正面與背面的電流路徑
列出移除支撐前必須保留的結構
practiceEn: Draw support bonding and electrical bonding separately
Mark frontside and backside current paths
List structures that must remain before a carrier is removed

pairs.transfer: 元件縮放與供電配置要共同設計：接觸、互連電阻和繞線空間會改變系統效能。
pairs.transferEn: Device scaling and power routing require co-design because contacts, interconnect resistance and routing space affect system performance.
pairs.difference: 先進節點名稱不是單一實體尺寸；奈米片電晶體與背面供電也是可分別研究的技術選項。
pairs.differenceEn: A node name is not a single physical dimension; nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery are separately assessable technology choices.
practice: 畫出元件、接觸與供電三個層次
比較正背面供電的線路壅塞
列出無法只靠節點名稱推斷的特性
practiceEn: Draw device, contact and power-routing levels
Compare routing congestion for frontside and backside power
List properties that a node name alone cannot establish

pairs.transfer: 提高數值孔徑必須聯動光學、光罩、晶圓掃描與焦點控制，不能只更換一片鏡子。
pairs.transferEn: Higher numerical aperture couples optics, masks, wafer scanning and focus control rather than changing one mirror alone.
pairs.difference: High-NA EUV 採用非等向縮放的反射式光學與不同曝光視場；整機工程另涵蓋光源、真空與計量閉迴路。
pairs.differenceEn: High-NA EUV uses anamorphic reflective optics and a different exposure field; system engineering also includes the source, vacuum and metrology loops.
practice: 標出光源到晶圓的功能鏈
比較等向與非等向縮放示意
為焦點誤差選一個可觀察訊號
practiceEn: Mark the functional chain from source to wafer
Compare isotropic and anamorphic reduction sketches
Choose an observable signal for focus error

pairs.transfer: 可印製的圖形、光阻反應與後續蝕刻共同限制最終器件形貌。
pairs.transferEn: Printed patterns, resist response and subsequent etching jointly constrain final device geometry.
pairs.difference: 高 NA 是曝光系統的光學參數；先進邏輯節點還涉及電晶體、接觸與互連，不能把 NA 當作節點尺寸。
pairs.differenceEn: High NA is an exposure-system optical parameter; a logic node also involves transistors, contacts and interconnects and is not an NA value.
practice: 區分光學影像與蝕刻後形貌
標出微影誤差可能傳遞的界面
列出節點評估所需的三類證據
practiceEn: Distinguish an optical image from the etched geometry
Mark interfaces where lithographic errors can propagate
List three kinds of evidence needed to assess a node

pairs.transfer: 縮小互連節距可提高接點密度；縮短垂直連線有助降低互連電阻與損失，但仍需共同評估接合、散熱、測試與良率。
pairs.transferEn: Finer interconnect pitch increases connection density; shorter vertical connections can reduce interconnect resistance and loss, while bonding, heat removal, testing and yield still need joint assessment.
pairs.difference: 混合接合是封裝整合的一種界面技術；先進封裝還包含中介層、基板、外部接點及多種不同連接方式。
pairs.differenceEn: Hybrid bonding is one integration-interface technology; advanced packaging also includes interposers, substrates, external terminals and other connection methods.
practice: 在封裝剖面圈出混合接合界面
追蹤一條訊號與一條熱流路徑
比較接合前與接合後可做的測試
practiceEn: Identify the hybrid-bond interface in a package section
Trace one signal path and one heat-flow path
Compare tests available before and after bonding

pairs.transfer: 高密度電連接與光學對位都需要界面公差預算、潔淨度與組裝後量測。
pairs.transferEn: Dense electrical connections and optical alignment both need interface-tolerance budgets, cleanliness and post-assembly measurements.
pairs.difference: 金屬接合以電性和接合完整性驗證；光引擎還要驗證耦合損耗、波長響應及光纖位置，兩者不是同一種對位。
pairs.differenceEn: Metal bonds are assessed electrically and mechanically; optical engines additionally require coupling-loss, spectral-response and fiber-position checks.
practice: 分開繪出電性與光學界面
比較電阻與耦合損耗的量測用途
標記熱膨脹可能改變的兩種對位
practiceEn: Draw electrical and optical interfaces separately
Compare resistance and coupling-loss measurements
Mark two alignments that thermal expansion may affect

pairs.transfer: 高電壓設備需共同考慮絕緣、散熱、電磁作用與保護配合。
pairs.transferEn: High-voltage equipment requires coordinated insulation, cooling, electromagnetic and protection design.
pairs.difference: 變壓器依交變磁通轉換交流電壓；直流換流站靠功率電子完成交流與直流轉換，變壓器本身不直接變換直流。
pairs.differenceEn: A transformer changes AC voltage through varying magnetic flux; an HVDC station uses power electronics for AC/DC conversion, and a transformer does not directly transform steady DC.
practice: 繪出交流側、變壓器與換流器
分辨繞組損失和半導體損失
列出兩種設備的絕緣驗證證據
practiceEn: Draw the AC side, transformer and converter
Distinguish winding and semiconductor losses
List insulation-verification evidence for both devices

pairs.transfer: 發電機輸出的電能需經升壓、開關與電網介面輸送，額定容量只是協作的一項條件。
pairs.transferEn: Generator output passes through step-up, switching and grid interfaces; rating is only one coordination requirement.
pairs.difference: 水電站把水能轉成旋轉與電能；變壓器改變電壓電流的配置，並不增加可輸出的總能量。
pairs.differenceEn: A hydropower plant converts water energy into rotation and electricity; a transformer changes the voltage-current relationship without increasing total available energy.
practice: 畫出水流到電網的能量鏈
標記發電機與變壓器的分界
以假想損失表檢查能量收支
practiceEn: Draw the energy chain from water flow to the grid
Mark the generator-transformer boundary
Check an energy balance using an illustrative loss table

pairs.transfer: 大型海上風電需要集電、海纜與岸上電網協調，直流輸電是跨越海陸介面的系統方案之一。
pairs.transferEn: Large offshore wind projects coordinate collection networks, subsea cables and the onshore grid; HVDC is one system solution across that boundary.
pairs.difference: 風機出力隨風況變化；換流站負責電能轉換和控制，不能把風機銘牌容量當成每時刻輸出。
pairs.differenceEn: Turbine output varies with wind; converters transform and control electrical power, so nameplate capacity is not continuous delivered output.
practice: 連接風機、海上站與岸上站
指出電壓轉換和交直流轉換位置
用兩種風況比較傳輸功率需求
practiceEn: Connect turbines, offshore station and onshore station
Locate voltage conversion and AC/DC conversion
Compare transmission demand under two wind conditions

pairs.transfer: 以電力驅動工業減碳時，電網介面、轉換損失和製程連續性必須共同規劃。
pairs.transferEn: Electrified industrial decarbonization requires joint planning of grid interfaces, conversion losses and process continuity.
pairs.difference: HYBRIT 的氫還原改變鋼鐵製程；HVDC 是輸電工程，兩者的類比限於電能供應與介面，不代表該試驗場採用特定 HVDC 方案。
pairs.differenceEn: HYBRIT changes ironmaking through hydrogen reduction; HVDC is transmission engineering. The analogy concerns electricity interfaces, not a claim that the pilot uses a particular HVDC scheme.
practice: 分開畫出電網與氫還原流程
列出不穩定供電可能影響的環節
把已知工程事實與假設情境分欄
practiceEn: Draw grid and hydrogen-reduction flows separately
List stages affected by interrupted power
Separate documented facts from hypothetical scenarios

pairs.transfer: 可信任服務既需要正確的軟體來源，也需要對多台機器狀態的一致認定；信任邊界應明確標示。
pairs.transferEn: Trustworthy services need authentic software and agreement about multi-machine state; trust boundaries must be explicit.
pairs.difference: 安全啟動驗證開機程式鏈；共識處理節點間的決策一致性，簽章正確不保證共識，共識也不保證韌體可信。
pairs.differenceEn: Secure boot authenticates a boot chain; consensus coordinates agreement among nodes. Valid signatures do not establish consensus, and consensus does not authenticate firmware.
practice: 把開機信任鏈與節點訊息分圖
提出一個更新失敗和一個節點故障
分別寫出恢復與稽核所需證據
practiceEn: Draw boot trust and node messages separately
Describe one failed update and one node failure
Specify recovery and audit evidence for each

pairs.transfer: 分層防禦需要把裝置完整性、身分驗證、網路分區和監控接成可稽核的信任鏈。
pairs.transferEn: Layered defense links device integrity, authentication, network segmentation and monitoring into an auditable trust chain.
pairs.difference: 安全啟動只處理部分開機完整性；防禦性網路還要管理權限、更新、紀錄與事故回應。
pairs.differenceEn: Secure boot addresses part of boot integrity; a defensive network also manages permissions, updates, logs and incident response.
practice: 把韌體信任根放進網路資產圖
找出安全啟動無法阻擋的設定錯誤
設計一個合法的完整性檢查紀錄
practiceEn: Place the firmware root of trust in an asset diagram
Identify a configuration error secure boot cannot prevent
Design a lawful integrity-check record

pairs.transfer: 可用性與完整性需要故障模型和可觀察證據，不能只因系統有多個副本就判斷安全。
pairs.transferEn: Availability and integrity require failure models and observable evidence; replicas alone do not establish security.
pairs.difference: 共識協定對故障與時序有特定假設；資安風險還包含身分、存取、機密性與管理程序。
pairs.differenceEn: Consensus protocols assume particular failures and timing; cybersecurity also covers identity, access, confidentiality and administrative processes.
practice: 畫出正常節點與中斷節點的訊息
區分故障容忍與權限控制
為一次復原寫出可檢查的事件紀錄
practiceEn: Draw messages for working and disconnected nodes
Separate fault tolerance from access control
Write an inspectable event record for recovery

pairs.transfer: 成像品質要透過像差、孔徑和對位共同評估，不能把解析度只歸因於放大倍率。
pairs.transferEn: Image quality depends on aberrations, aperture and alignment rather than magnification alone.
pairs.difference: 可見光消色差雙合透鏡利用不同材料的色散互補；EUV 微影主要使用多層膜反射鏡，不能照搬透鏡解法。
pairs.differenceEn: Visible-light achromatic doublets combine material dispersions; EUV lithography mainly uses multilayer mirrors, so the lens solution cannot be transferred directly.
practice: 分別畫出透射與反射光路
區分色差與幾何像差
說明為何材料透明性限制光學架構
practiceEn: Draw transmitted and reflected ray paths
Distinguish chromatic and geometric aberration
Explain how material transparency constrains optical architecture

pairs.transfer: 精密光學要以波段、像差和熱形變建立誤差預算，最後用實測波前或影像驗證。
pairs.transferEn: Precision optics require error budgets for wavelength, aberrations and thermal distortion, followed by wavefront or image measurements.
pairs.difference: 消色差透鏡補償折射色散；Webb 使用分段反射鏡和低溫環境，主要問題是鏡段共相與熱穩定。
pairs.differenceEn: Achromatic lenses compensate refractive dispersion; Webb uses segmented mirrors in a cold environment, emphasizing segment phasing and thermal stability.
practice: 比較雙合透鏡與分段反射鏡
標出溫度變化會改變的尺寸
為色差與鏡段失準各選一種觀察量
practiceEn: Compare a doublet with a segmented reflector
Mark dimensions affected by temperature
Choose observables for chromatic error and segment misalignment

pairs.transfer: 旋翼機與固定翼客機都必須把載荷、疲勞、操縱與維修性聯合驗證；本比較限於公開航空原理。
pairs.transferEn: Rotorcraft and fixed-wing aircraft both coordinate loads, fatigue, control and maintainability; this comparison stays within public aviation principles.
pairs.difference: 旋翼的周期性載荷與固定機翼受力不同；民航客機的結構和系統配置不能直接套用到旋翼機。
pairs.differenceEn: Periodic rotor loads differ from fixed-wing loading; civil-airliner structures and systems cannot be transferred directly to a helicopter.
practice: 標示旋翼與固定翼升力來源
比較振動與疲勞的觀察位置
建立不含武器系統的檢驗清單
practiceEn: Identify rotor and fixed-wing lift sources
Compare vibration and fatigue observation points
Create an inspection list excluding weapon systems

pairs.transfer: 旋轉關節都需要位置回授、致動和載荷限制，可透過簡化運動模型學習控制介面。
pairs.transferEn: Rotating joints need position feedback, actuation and load limits, which can be studied with simplified motion models.
pairs.difference: 機械手臂關節定位與旋翼航空器的飛行控制屬不同動力系統；桌面模型不能推導真機控制律。
pairs.differenceEn: Robot-joint positioning and rotorcraft flight control have different dynamics; a desktop model cannot establish an aircraft control law.
practice: 畫出致動器、感測器與回授
比較一個關節與旋翼的自由度
寫出模型未涵蓋的動態因素
practiceEn: Draw actuator, sensor and feedback paths
Compare a joint and a rotor degree of freedom
List dynamics omitted from the model

pairs.transfer: 兩座懸索橋都把橋面荷載經吊索、主纜、橋塔與錨碇傳遞到地盤。
pairs.transferEn: Both suspension bridges transfer deck loads through hangers, main cables, towers and anchorages into the ground.
pairs.difference: 海峽風況、地震、航道與跨度不同；可以移用受力路徑概念，不能複製纜索尺寸或施工順序。
pairs.differenceEn: Wind, seismic conditions, navigation channels and spans differ; the load-path concept transfers, but cable dimensions and construction sequences do not.
practice: 沿兩座橋各畫一次重力傳遞
標出主纜與垂直吊索的角色
比較風與地震需要的證據
practiceEn: Trace gravity loads through each bridge
Distinguish main cables from vertical hangers
Compare evidence needed for wind and seismic effects

pairs.transfer: 跨水域纜索支承橋都需要控制施工階段受力、橋面幾何與風致反應。
pairs.transferEn: Cable-supported water crossings need construction-stage force control, deck geometry control and wind-response assessment.
pairs.difference: 明石海峽大橋是懸索橋；淡江大橋是斜張橋，橋面到橋塔的荷載路徑與錨碇角色不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Akashi Kaikyo is a suspension bridge; Danjiang is cable-stayed, giving different deck-to-tower load paths and anchorage roles.
practice: 分色描出主纜、吊索與斜拉索
比較施工未合龍時的受力
指出不能互換的纜索配置
practiceEn: Color-code main cables, hangers and stay cables
Compare forces before deck closure
Identify cable arrangements that cannot be interchanged

pairs.transfer: 細長大型結構都須考慮風引起的位移、振動與使用舒適度。
pairs.transferEn: Large slender structures must address wind-driven displacement, vibration and occupant or user comfort.
pairs.difference: 金門大橋的橋面與纜索形成跨越系統；台北 101 的核心、柱和阻尼裝置屬高層建築系統。
pairs.differenceEn: Golden Gate uses a spanning deck-and-cable system; Taipei 101 uses a high-rise system of core, columns and damping devices.
practice: 標出兩個結構主要振動方向
比較剛度增加與阻尼增加
說明縮尺模型需保留哪些相似條件
practiceEn: Mark principal vibration directions in both structures
Compare added stiffness with added damping
State which similarity conditions a scale model must preserve

pairs.transfer: 橋梁都要把路面荷載可靠地傳到基礎，並在施工過程維持幾何與平衡。
pairs.transferEn: Bridges must transfer roadway loads reliably to foundations while controlling geometry and equilibrium during construction.
pairs.difference: 金門大橋是主纜與吊索的懸索系統；淡江大橋以斜拉索連接橋面和橋塔，不能畫成同一種纜索圖。
pairs.differenceEn: Golden Gate uses main cables and hangers; Danjiang connects deck and tower through stays, so their cable diagrams must differ.
practice: 畫出兩種橋型的基本受力圖
比較塔頂與錨碇承擔的作用
選擇一個施工階段檢查平衡
practiceEn: Draw the basic load path of each bridge type
Compare tower-top and anchorage functions
Check equilibrium for one construction stage

pairs.transfer: 高塔與高層建築都依賴基礎、結構連接和動態控制，把風與地震作用分配到可承擔的構件。
pairs.transferEn: Bridge towers and tall buildings distribute wind and seismic actions through foundations, structural connections and dynamic control.
pairs.difference: 橋塔受斜拉索牽引並服務橋面；建築物還承受樓層與人員使用條件，阻尼裝置的配置目的不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Bridge towers carry cable forces serving a deck; buildings also carry floors and occupancy demands, giving different damping-system requirements.
practice: 標記橋塔與建築核心的荷載
比較基礎需要抵抗的作用
寫出不能用外形類似推斷的性能
practiceEn: Mark loads on a bridge tower and building core
Compare foundation actions
List performance that visual resemblance cannot establish

pairs.transfer: 長距離雙孔鐵路隧道都要把開挖、襯砌、軌道與逃生通道整合成營運系統。
pairs.transferEn: Long twin-bore rail tunnels integrate excavation, lining, track and evacuation connections into an operating system.
pairs.difference: 英法海底隧道跨越海峽；哥達基線隧道穿越深埋山體，地層、地下水、溫度與施工入口條件不同。
pairs.differenceEn: The Channel Tunnel crosses beneath a strait; Gotthard runs beneath a mountain massif, with different geology, groundwater, temperature and access conditions.
practice: 畫出主隧道與聯絡通道
比較水壓和高覆土的工程影響
為撤離路徑寫出可驗證的要求
practiceEn: Draw running tunnels and cross-connections
Compare water-pressure and deep-cover effects
State verifiable evacuation-route requirements

pairs.transfer: 在水域下活動都需要辨認壓力邊界、滲漏路徑和失效後的隔離條件。
pairs.transferEn: Operations beneath water require explicit pressure boundaries, leakage paths and failure-isolation conditions.
pairs.difference: 海底隧道是固定於地層中的土建設施；Alvin 是可移動的載人潛器，浮力、壓力殼與支援方式不能互換。
pairs.differenceEn: A subsea tunnel is fixed civil infrastructure within the ground; Alvin is a moving crewed submersible with different buoyancy, pressure-hull and support requirements.
practice: 圈出兩個系統的乾濕邊界
比較滲漏偵測的觀察位置
分開列出固定設施與載具限制
practiceEn: Outline dry-wet boundaries in each system
Compare leakage observation points
Separate fixed-infrastructure and vehicle constraints

pairs.transfer: 隧道工程都需依地質證據調整施工，並把通風、排水、監控與避難整合。
pairs.transferEn: Tunnel construction responds to geological evidence and integrates ventilation, drainage, monitoring and refuge.
pairs.difference: 英法海底隧道以鐵路列車運行；雪山隧道服務公路車流，火災情境、通風需求與人員分布不同。
pairs.differenceEn: The Channel Tunnel serves rail traffic; Hsuehshan serves road vehicles, producing different fire scenarios, ventilation needs and occupant distributions.
practice: 比較公路與鐵路隧道剖面
標示地質未知資訊如何影響工序
為兩種交通情境各列一項監測
practiceEn: Compare road and rail tunnel sections
Show how geological uncertainty affects work stages
List one monitoring need for each traffic scenario

pairs.transfer: 長期處於水環境的設施和載具，都需要壓力邊界、腐蝕管理及滲漏偵測的概念。
pairs.transferEn: Water-exposed structures and vehicles both require pressure-boundary, corrosion-management and leakage-detection concepts.
pairs.difference: 海底隧道由地層和襯砌共同作用；水下載具靠獨立殼體與浮力控制，本比較不涉及軍用性能或製造規格。
pairs.differenceEn: Subsea tunnels rely on ground-lining interaction; underwater vehicles use independent hulls and buoyancy control. This comparison excludes military performance and manufacturing specifications.
practice: 分辨地層支承與獨立殼體
畫出公開概念層級的水壓方向
說明兩者維修接近方式的差異
practiceEn: Distinguish ground support from an independent hull
Draw water-pressure directions at a conceptual level
Compare maintenance-access conditions

pairs.transfer: 高速鐵路的軌道幾何、供電、訊號與維護窗口，要在土建限制下形成完整介面。
pairs.transferEn: High-speed rail geometry, power, signaling and maintenance windows must fit civil-infrastructure constraints.
pairs.difference: 哥達以長基線隧道為主要場景；台灣高鐵跨越隧道、橋梁和路堤，環境暴露和維護接近性不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Gotthard centers on a long base tunnel; Taiwan HSR includes tunnels, viaducts and embankments, with different environmental exposure and maintenance access.
practice: 在隧道剖面配置鐵路介面
比較橋上與隧道內的檢修限制
追蹤一個軌道幾何偏差的影響
practiceEn: Place rail interfaces within a tunnel section
Compare maintenance constraints on a viaduct and in a tunnel
Trace the effects of one track-geometry deviation

pairs.transfer: 山岳隧道需要探勘、開挖回饋、支撐及排水的反覆判斷，地質模型必須隨證據修正。
pairs.transferEn: Mountain tunnels use iterative investigation, excavation feedback, support and drainage decisions, updating geological models with evidence.
pairs.difference: 哥達是深埋鐵路基線隧道；雪山是公路隧道，不能把開挖機型、支護間距或營運通風直接移植。
pairs.differenceEn: Gotthard is a deeply buried rail base tunnel and Hsuehshan a road tunnel; excavation equipment, support spacing and ventilation are not transferable settings.
practice: 標示探勘與實際開挖的回饋
比較公路與鐵路的空間需求
寫出遇到新地質證據時的審查點
practiceEn: Mark investigation-excavation feedback
Compare road and rail spatial requirements
Define a review point for new geological evidence

pairs.transfer: 混凝土水工結構與閘門都需控制水位、水壓、滲流和接縫，並以量測驗證運轉。
pairs.transferEn: Concrete hydraulic structures and gates manage water level, pressure, seepage and joints through measured operating evidence.
pairs.difference: 胡佛壩主要蓄水發電；巴拿馬新船閘循環改變閘室水位讓船舶通過，水量利用方式不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Hoover primarily stores water and generates power; Panama locks cycle chamber levels to move vessels, using water differently.
practice: 分開畫出蓄水與過閘流程
追蹤一道閘門兩側的水位
比較滲流監測與閘室水量紀錄
practiceEn: Draw reservoir storage and lock transit separately
Track water levels on both sides of a gate
Compare seepage monitoring with chamber water accounting

pairs.transfer: 大型水壩都需把地質基礎、混凝土溫控、水流與水輪發電介面共同評估。
pairs.transferEn: Large dams coordinate geological foundations, concrete temperature control, flow and turbine-generator interfaces.
pairs.difference: 胡佛壩為拱重力壩；三峽為重力壩，峽谷形狀、受力途徑、泄洪和航運條件不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Hoover is an arch-gravity dam and Three Gorges a gravity dam, differing in valley shape, load paths, spillway and navigation conditions.
practice: 畫出向兩岸與向基礎傳力的差別
比較大體積混凝土熱量管理
列出不能依壩高直接推估的效能
practiceEn: Compare load transfer toward abutments and foundations
Compare mass-concrete heat management
List performance that dam height alone cannot predict

pairs.transfer: 循環利用水資源必須先建立水量收支，再界定不同用途需要的水質和監測。
pairs.transferEn: Water reuse begins with a water balance and explicit quality and monitoring requirements for each use.
pairs.difference: 船閘節水池回用過閘用水；NEWater 以處理單元取得特定再生水品質，節省水量不等於淨化水質。
pairs.differenceEn: Lock-saving basins reuse lockage water; NEWater uses treatment processes to achieve specified reclaimed-water quality. Saving volume does not imply purification.
practice: 畫出回用水的去向而不混淆水質
分開列出水量和水質量測
用假想流量檢查一個循環收支
practiceEn: Trace reused water without conflating water quality
List volume and quality measurements separately
Check a cycle balance with illustrative flows

pairs.transfer: 船閘需要透過水位控制跨越高程差，水力結構與船舶營運必須協調。
pairs.transferEn: Locks use water-level control to cross elevation differences, coordinating hydraulic structures and vessel operations.
pairs.difference: 巴拿馬運河串接海洋與湖泊通道；三峽航運設施跨越大壩水位差，尺度、通航配置與水文邊界不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Panama links ocean and lake navigation; Three Gorges navigation crosses a dam-level difference, with different scale, layout and hydrological boundaries.
practice: 畫出船舶進出時的水位序列
辨認閘門開啟前需確認的狀態
比較節水與通航能力的取捨
practiceEn: Draw the water-level sequence during a transit
Identify states checked before gate opening
Compare water conservation and transit capacity

pairs.transfer: 軌道運輸都把車輛、軌道、供電和行車控制結合，安全距離與制動必須有可追溯依據。
pairs.transferEn: Rail systems integrate rolling stock, track, power and train control, with traceable evidence for separation and braking.
pairs.difference: 高鐵著重長距離高速運行；捷運需面對密集停站與短班距，不能共用一組制動或號誌設定。
pairs.differenceEn: HSR emphasizes long-distance high-speed service; metro systems have frequent stops and short headways, requiring different braking and signaling parameters.
practice: 畫出列車到控制中心的介面
比較停站頻率對能耗的影響
為班距與制動距離分別標示依據
practiceEn: Draw interfaces between train and control center
Compare effects of stopping frequency on energy
Identify evidence for headway and braking distance

pairs.transfer: 輪軌接觸、黏著、制動和車輛載荷是跨世代鐵路共同的工程問題。
pairs.transferEn: Wheel-rail contact, adhesion, braking and vehicle loads remain shared rail-engineering concerns across generations.
pairs.difference: 蒸汽機車以鍋爐與往復機構供能；高鐵以電力牽引和現代控制運行，熱源與傳動架構不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Steam locomotives use boilers and reciprocating machinery; HSR uses electric traction and modern control, with different energy and transmission architectures.
practice: 並列兩種車輛的能量轉換鏈
找出共通的輪軌界面
說明提高速度後不能沿用的假設
practiceEn: Draw both energy-conversion chains
Identify the shared wheel-rail interface
Explain assumptions that fail as speed increases

pairs.transfer: 工業用水與資源交換需要確認供需量、品質、管線介面和中斷後的替代方案。
pairs.transferEn: Industrial water and resource exchange require quantity, quality, pipeline-interface and interruption planning.
pairs.difference: NEWater 是水處理與供應體系；卡倫堡交換多種物料和能源，不能以單一水質指標管理所有流。
pairs.differenceEn: NEWater treats and supplies water; Kalundborg exchanges multiple materials and energy streams, so one water-quality metric cannot govern every flow.
practice: 為每條交換流標示用途和品質
區分回收水、蒸汽與副產物
提出一方停機時的替代情境
practiceEn: Label purpose and quality for each exchange stream
Distinguish reclaimed water, steam and by-products
Describe a contingency when one partner stops

pairs.transfer: 兩種複材客機都要把纖維方向、接頭、損傷檢測和系統安裝一起考慮。
pairs.transferEn: Both composite airliners integrate fiber orientation, joints, damage inspection and system installation.
pairs.difference: A350 與 787 的機身製造分段及機電配置不同；複材占比不能直接決定維修程序或電力架構。
pairs.differenceEn: A350 and 787 differ in fuselage manufacturing divisions and system architecture; composite percentage alone does not determine repair procedures or electrical design.
practice: 比較板件與筒段的概念接口
標記接頭與線束可能交會的位置
為內部損傷選擇可驗證證據
practiceEn: Compare conceptual panel and barrel interfaces
Mark intersections of joints and wiring
Identify evidence for internal damage

pairs.transfer: 航空裝配與機器人作業都需要座標基準、治具定位、操作順序與量測回饋。
pairs.transferEn: Aircraft assembly and robot operations both depend on coordinate frames, fixtures, sequencing and measurement feedback.
pairs.difference: A350 是整機和供應鏈整合案例；UR5 是通用手臂學習案例，此比較不宣稱 A350 產線使用該特定型號。
pairs.differenceEn: A350 illustrates aircraft and supply-chain integration; UR5 illustrates a general robot arm. This comparison does not claim that A350 production uses that model.
practice: 畫出零件、治具與工具座標
比較人工作業與機械手臂的可達性
列出教學軌跡進入真實產線前缺的證據
practiceEn: Draw part, fixture and tool coordinate frames
Compare human and robot reachability
List evidence missing before a teaching path could enter production

pairs.transfer: 不同航空器都以需求、結構、系統介面和試驗證據形成可追溯的工程鏈。
pairs.transferEn: Different aircraft connect requirements, structures, system interfaces and test evidence through traceable engineering.
pairs.difference: 民航與軍用航空器的任務和認證條件不同；比較只涵蓋公開材料、裝配與品質概念。
pairs.differenceEn: Civil and military aircraft have different missions and certification contexts; this comparison covers only public materials, assembly and quality concepts.
practice: 為兩者畫出非武器系統分解
比較組裝基準與品質紀錄
列出不同任務引起的公開需求差異
practiceEn: Draw non-weapon system breakdowns
Compare assembly datums and quality records
List public requirement differences arising from mission

pairs.transfer: 航空電力、結構與裝配不能各自獨立決策，重量、散熱和可維修性會互相約束。
pairs.transferEn: Aircraft electrical, structural and assembly decisions interact through weight, cooling and maintainability.
pairs.difference: 787 的公開民航電力架構與經國號的公開產業史只提供不同研究切面；不能據此推定軍用電路或性能。
pairs.differenceEn: Public 787 electrical architecture and the IDF program’s public industrial history offer different research perspectives; neither establishes military circuits or performance.
practice: 只列公開可查的系統介面
比較重量與散熱的取捨
對未知設計欄位保留待查標記
practiceEn: List only publicly documented system interfaces
Compare weight and cooling trade-offs
Mark unknown design fields for further research

pairs.transfer: 更多功能改由電力驅動後，配電、功率轉換、散熱和故障隔離成為整機共同問題。
pairs.transferEn: Electrifying more functions makes distribution, conversion, cooling and fault isolation system-wide concerns.
pairs.difference: 電動車以電池儲能牽引；787 仍以航空燃油驅動發動機並產生電力，不能稱作電池電動飛機。
pairs.differenceEn: An EV stores traction energy in batteries; the 787 still uses fuel-powered engines and electrical generation, so it is not a battery-electric aircraft.
practice: 畫出燃料與電池的能量來源
比較電力分配和推進的關係
為兩種系統標示一個散熱瓶頸
practiceEn: Draw fuel and battery energy sources
Compare power distribution with propulsion
Mark one cooling bottleneck in each system

pairs.transfer: 水下載具都需以浮力、穩定、外部壓力和艙體完整性建立系統思考。
pairs.transferEn: Underwater vehicles share system questions of buoyancy, stability, external pressure and compartment integrity.
pairs.difference: Alvin 是科學潛器，國造潛艦案例只作公開工程概念；任務、尺度和支援方式不同，不能推定軍用設計。
pairs.differenceEn: Alvin is a scientific submersible; the domestic-submarine case covers public engineering concepts only. Missions, scale and support differ, and military designs cannot be inferred.
practice: 分開標示排水體積與重量
比較研究任務與載具支援方式
列出只有合格測試才可確認的性能
practiceEn: Distinguish displaced volume from weight
Compare research missions and vehicle support
List performance requiring qualified testing

pairs.transfer: 車輛都需把扭矩需求、傳動、散熱和製造公差對應到實際駕駛情境。
pairs.transferEn: Vehicles link torque demand, transmission, cooling and manufacturing tolerances to driving scenarios.
pairs.difference: Prius 課程以油電能量管理為核心；Ferrari 課程以精密製造和性能取捨為切面，不代表所有 Ferrari 都採同一動力型式。
pairs.differenceEn: The Prius course centers on hybrid energy management; Ferrari emphasizes precision manufacturing and performance trade-offs, without assuming a single powertrain across all Ferrari models.
practice: 選定明確車型與研究年代
畫出加速和制動的能量流
比較效率、性能與量產公差目標
practiceEn: Specify vehicle model and study period
Draw acceleration and braking energy flows
Compare efficiency, performance and production-tolerance goals

pairs.transfer: 電動牽引與再生制動都需要協調馬達、功率電子和可接收回收能量的儲能或供電系統。
pairs.transferEn: Electric traction and regenerative braking coordinate motors, power electronics and energy storage or a supply system capable of receiving recovered energy.
pairs.difference: Prius 主要回充車載電池；捷運可能回送供電網、供其他列車使用或儲能，取決於系統配置。
pairs.differenceEn: Prius primarily recovers energy into its battery; metro systems may feed the supply network, other trains or storage, depending on configuration.
practice: 畫出制動時反向能量流
說明能量無法回收時的替代去向
比較車載儲能與供電網介面
practiceEn: Draw reverse energy flow during braking
Explain alternatives when recovery is unavailable
Compare onboard storage with supply-network interfaces

pairs.transfer: 油電車和電池電動車都依賴逆變器、馬達、電池管理及再生制動。
pairs.transferEn: Hybrid and battery-electric vehicles both rely on inverters, motors, battery management and regenerative braking.
pairs.difference: Prius 具有引擎與動力分流；Tesla 電池電動車依靠外部充電和車載電池，運行與能量補給模型不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Prius combines an engine with power splitting; Tesla battery-electric vehicles use external charging and onboard batteries, producing different operating and replenishment models.
practice: 並列兩套能量流圖
比較低速、巡航與制動情境
把續航估算中的假設逐項寫出
practiceEn: Draw both energy-flow systems
Compare low-speed, cruise and braking scenarios
List assumptions used in a range estimate

pairs.transfer: 太空科學儀器都要把光學、偵測器、熱控制、指向和地面校準資料接成量測鏈。
pairs.transferEn: Space instruments connect optics, detectors, thermal control, pointing and ground calibration into a measurement chain.
pairs.difference: Landsat 量測地球表面；Webb 觀測遠方天體，波段、軌道、熱環境和校準目標不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Landsat measures Earth’s surface; Webb observes distant astronomical targets, differing in bands, orbit, thermal environment and calibration targets.
practice: 追蹤光子到可用資料的路徑
比較地球與天文目標的背景
列出儀器讀值轉為科學資料的修正
practiceEn: Trace photons to usable data
Compare Earth and astronomical backgrounds
List corrections from instrument readings to science data

pairs.transfer: 光訊號轉成電訊號都需理解波段響應、雜訊、校準和介面損失。
pairs.transferEn: Converting optical signals into electrical signals requires spectral-response, noise, calibration and interface-loss analysis.
pairs.difference: Landsat 感測地表輻射；矽光子光引擎主要傳送資訊，本類比不表示 Landsat 採用課程中的 CPO 架構。
pairs.differenceEn: Landsat senses surface radiance; silicon-photonic engines mainly carry information. This analogy does not claim that Landsat uses the course’s CPO architecture.
practice: 比較環境光與調變訊號來源
列出偵測器與傳輸器的不同指標
標出類比成立與不成立的介面
practiceEn: Compare environmental light and modulated sources
List different sensing and communication metrics
Mark interfaces where the analogy does and does not hold

pairs.transfer: 衛星系統都需要軌道、電力、姿態、通訊及地面處理的協調。
pairs.transferEn: Satellite systems coordinate orbit, power, attitude, communications and ground processing.
pairs.difference: Landsat 以長期一致的地球觀測資料為目標；Starlink 以通信服務為目標，軌道配置、資料流和效能指標不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Landsat targets consistent long-term Earth observations; Starlink targets communication service, with different orbital configurations, data flows and performance measures.
practice: 畫出衛星與地面的資料閉環
比較影像品質和通信延遲指標
列出同名子系統的不同需求
practiceEn: Draw the satellite-ground data loop
Compare image-quality and communication-latency metrics
List differing requirements for similarly named subsystems

pairs.transfer: 部署、電力、通訊和熱控制都需要在太空環境下驗證，地面可修復性不能直接假定。
pairs.transferEn: Deployment, power, communications and thermal control require verification for space, without assuming terrestrial repair access.
pairs.difference: Webb 是單一深空科學觀測站；Starlink 是低軌通訊星系，軌道和部署規模使冗餘策略不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Webb is a single deep-space science observatory; Starlink is a low-Earth-orbit communications constellation, yielding different redundancy strategies.
practice: 比較單一觀測站和大量衛星的介面
說明地面通訊延遲的不同用途
為部署後無法調整的條件建立清單
practiceEn: Compare one observatory with a large constellation
Explain differing communication-delay implications
List constraints that become difficult to change after deployment

pairs.transfer: 精密裝配與機械手臂都需要工件定位、工具座標、力與尺寸回饋。
pairs.transferEn: Precision assembly and robot arms both need workpiece location, tool frames and force or dimensional feedback.
pairs.difference: Ferrari 製造涉及多種人機協作工序；UR5 是教學手臂案例，本比較不宣稱特定 Ferrari 產線使用 UR5。
pairs.differenceEn: Ferrari production includes varied human-machine operations; UR5 is a teaching example, not a claim about equipment on a particular Ferrari line.
practice: 選一個非品牌專屬的定位任務
定義工件與工具的座標
比較尺寸合格與動作到位的差別
practiceEn: Choose a brand-independent positioning task
Define workpiece and tool coordinates
Distinguish dimensional acceptance from reaching a pose

pairs.transfer: 大型再生能源都把自然能量轉成機械和電力，再透過電網介面交付。
pairs.transferEn: Large renewable-energy projects convert natural energy into mechanical and electrical energy before grid delivery.
pairs.difference: 伊泰普以可調度水流驅動水輪機；離岸風電受風況影響，儲能條件、機組配置和維護環境不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Itaipu uses controlled water flow through turbines; offshore wind varies with wind conditions, with different storage context, machine layouts and maintenance environments.
practice: 畫出水輪與風輪的能量鏈
比較可控輸入與天候輸入
列出容量之外應記錄的運行資料
practiceEn: Draw hydro and wind energy chains
Compare controllable and weather-driven inputs
List operating data needed beyond nameplate capacity

pairs.transfer: 水電樞紐都需要統整水庫、進水、壓力水路、機組和輸電，並評估環境與河流調度。
pairs.transferEn: Hydropower complexes integrate reservoir, intake, pressure-water routes, machines and transmission with river and environmental management.
pairs.difference: 伊泰普跨巴西與巴拉圭；三峽兼有大型航運配置，水文、治理和營運目標不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Itaipu spans Brazil and Paraguay; Three Gorges includes major navigation facilities, with different hydrology, governance and operating objectives.
practice: 標出水路和電路的交接
比較水庫調度的多重目標
用假想水頭與流量作量綱檢查
practiceEn: Mark the water-to-electricity interface
Compare competing reservoir objectives
Check dimensions using illustrative head and flow values

pairs.transfer: 工業減碳需要以系統邊界追蹤能源、物料和副產物流，避免只看單一設備效率。
pairs.transferEn: Industrial decarbonization tracks energy, material and by-product flows across defined boundaries rather than one device’s efficiency.
pairs.difference: HYBRIT 改變還原鐵的製程路徑；卡倫堡將多家工廠的資源互相串接，兩者的減碳機制不同。
pairs.differenceEn: HYBRIT changes the iron-reduction route; Kalundborg connects resource flows across companies, using different decarbonization mechanisms.
practice: 畫出廠內製程與跨廠交換邊界
列出直接與間接能源需求
對缺乏資料的排放量保留未知
practiceEn: Draw within-plant and cross-company boundaries
List direct and indirect energy demands
Keep unmeasured emissions explicitly unknown

pairs.transfer: 斷層影像都需把量測幾何、校準、雜訊與重建方法連成可驗證流程。
pairs.transferEn: Tomographic imaging connects measurement geometry, calibration, noise and reconstruction into a verifiable process.
pairs.difference: CT 量測外部 X 光的衰減；PET 偵測體內示蹤相關的成對光子。EXPLORER PET/CT 的兩類量測不可混稱。
pairs.differenceEn: CT measures attenuation of external X-rays; PET detects paired photons associated with an internal tracer. The two measurements in EXPLORER PET/CT must remain distinct.
practice: 分色畫出 CT 與 PET 訊號來源
比較投影與符合事件資料
用合成資料說明校準偏差
practiceEn: Color-code CT and PET signal sources
Compare projections and coincidence-event data
Illustrate calibration bias with synthetic data

pairs.transfer: 大型探測和斷層量測都需要幾何校準、通道讀出、資料品質與重建驗證。
pairs.transferEn: Large detectors and tomography both require geometry calibration, channel readout, data quality and reconstruction checks.
pairs.difference: CT 重建物體衰減分布；LHC 實驗探測粒子碰撞事件，訊號來源和反演目標完全不同。
pairs.differenceEn: CT reconstructs attenuation within an object; LHC experiments measure collision events, with different signal sources and inverse problems.
practice: 畫出偵測器到資料的共同鏈
指出兩種重建想回答的不同問題
為一個失效通道設計品質標記
practiceEn: Draw the shared detector-to-data chain
Identify the different reconstruction questions
Design a quality flag for a failed channel

pairs.transfer: PET 與粒子實驗都依賴多通道偵測、時間資訊、事件篩選和校準資料。
pairs.transferEn: PET and particle experiments both use multichannel detection, timing information, event selection and calibration data.
pairs.difference: PET 符合事件用於醫學影像；LHC 碰撞事件包含多種粒子與探測層。本教學比較不是臨床掃描或放射操作指南。
pairs.differenceEn: PET coincidences support medical imaging; LHC collisions involve multiple particles and detector layers. This comparison is not a clinical scanning or radiation-operation guide.
practice: 比較兩個符合訊號與多粒子事件
標記時間偏差對資料的影響
用合成事件說明品質篩選
practiceEn: Compare paired coincidences with multiparticle events
Mark effects of timing offsets
Demonstrate quality selection with synthetic events

pairs.transfer: 整車工程需要讓結構、動力、熱管理、軟體和製造品質互相符合。
pairs.transferEn: Vehicle engineering aligns structure, powertrain, thermal management, software and manufacturing quality.
pairs.difference: 品牌不能替代技術分類；比較前必須指定 Ferrari 車型及 Tesla 電池電動車情境，避免把所有車型說成同一架構。
pairs.differenceEn: Brands do not define a single technical class; specify a Ferrari model and a Tesla battery-electric scenario before comparing architectures.
practice: 先固定比較車型和任務
並列動力與熱流路徑
比較裝配公差如何影響整車驗證
practiceEn: Fix the vehicle models and missions
Compare power and heat-flow paths
Explain how assembly tolerances affect vehicle verification

pairs.transfer: 無論能源來源如何改變，軌道車輛都要處理黏著、輪軌導向、制動與載荷傳遞。
pairs.transferEn: Regardless of energy source, rail vehicles address adhesion, wheel-rail guidance, braking and load transfer.
pairs.difference: 蒸汽機車用燃料、鍋爐與汽缸；捷運以電力牽引並與行車控制整合，控制與維護界面不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Steam locomotives use fuel, boilers and cylinders; metros integrate electric traction with train control, changing control and maintenance interfaces.
practice: 畫出共同的輪軌受力
比較蒸汽與電力能量轉換
為一次停止分開標示能量與控制
practiceEn: Draw shared wheel-rail forces
Compare steam and electrical energy conversion
Separate energy and control during a stop

pairs.transfer: 電力牽引都需要電源、逆變器、馬達、回生與熱管理形成閉環。
pairs.transferEn: Electric traction closes the loop among supply, inverter, motor, regeneration and thermal management.
pairs.difference: Tesla 使用車載電池與輪胎道路接觸；捷運多由外部供電並受軌道引導，供電和附著條件不同。
pairs.differenceEn: Tesla uses onboard batteries and tire-road contact; metros commonly use external power and rail guidance, with different supply and adhesion conditions.
practice: 比較電源位於車上或路側
畫出加速與制動的相反流向
列出輪胎和鋼輪接觸不能混用的假設
practiceEn: Compare onboard and wayside energy supply
Draw opposite acceleration and braking flows
List assumptions that differ for tires and steel wheels

pairs.transfer: 封裝和光引擎都要協調晶片、基板、散熱與測試，介面品質決定整體良率。
pairs.transferEn: Packaging and optical engines coordinate chips, substrates, cooling and testing; interface quality shapes overall yield.
pairs.difference: 一般電性封裝以電連接為核心；矽光子還加入波導、光纖與光學耦合，不能只用導通測試判斷成功。
pairs.differenceEn: Electrical packaging centers on electrical connections; silicon photonics adds waveguides, fibers and optical coupling, so continuity tests alone cannot establish success.
practice: 在封裝剖面分色電與光
比較接點電阻和耦合損耗
列出組裝前後各可驗證的介面
practiceEn: Color-code electrical and optical package paths
Compare contact resistance and coupling loss
List interfaces testable before and after assembly

pairs.transfer: 先進電晶體仍依靠微影、沉積、蝕刻、摻雜、清洗與量測的整合，但順序和互相約束更複雜。
pairs.transferEn: Advanced transistors still integrate lithography, deposition, etching, doping, cleaning and metrology, with more complex dependencies.
pairs.difference: 通用晶圓流程教學不等於特定先進節點配方；奈米片、接觸與背面供電等選項需分別說明證據。
pairs.differenceEn: A general wafer curriculum is not a recipe for a specific advanced node; nanosheets, contacts and backside power require separate evidence.
practice: 把共通單元工序連到元件剖面
標出先進架構新增的依賴
分辨公開原理與未公開製程參數
practiceEn: Connect common unit operations to a device section
Mark new dependencies in advanced architectures
Separate public principles from undisclosed process parameters

editorialScope: 原創比較教案：引用來源支持個別工程與原理，專案間的教學類比是編者整理；不宣稱互相採用相同商用設備或設計。
editorialScopeEn: Original comparison lessons: references support the individual projects and principles; cross-project teaching analogies are editorial synthesis, not claims of shared commercial equipment or designs.
